title: TC-P0-1: should render header with correct data-test selectors on all four AiPageShell pages
verifies: Sessions, LLM Insights, Agent Graph, and Agent Behavior pages each render the page container, date-time picker, labeled Refresh button, and last-refreshed indicator span with correct data-test attributes

title: TC-P0-2: should render Quality tab header with correct selectors
verifies: Quality tab embedded inside AI Observability renders quality-page, quality-last-refreshed, quality-time-range-picker, and quality-refresh-btn selectors

title: TC-P0-3: should preserve header pattern when navigating between AI pages via secondary rail
verifies: Clicking secondary rail items transitions between LLM Insights → Sessions → Agent Graph → Agent Behavior, each preserving the header pattern with its page-specific data-test prefix

title: TC-P1-1: should show loading state on Refresh click and recover on Sessions page
verifies: Clicking Refresh disables the button + shows a spinner; after the fetch settles the button becomes enabled again; if LLM/trace data exists the last-refreshed indicator appears with a green dot

title: TC-P1-2: should persist shared date range across page navigations — not wired: date picker internal selectors for relative-time selection on AI-specific DateTime picker are not yet confirmed (see AiPageShell.vue DateTime component); needs same investigation as dashboard date-time helpers
verifies: Date picker value persists across LLM Insights → Sessions → Quality via useAiDateRange singleton (test.fixme pending date picker interaction confirmation)

title: TC-P1-3: should trigger loading state on Quality tab Refresh and recover
verifies: Quality Refresh button enters loading state on click and recovers; if evaluator data exists the quality-last-refreshed indicator appears with a green dot

title: TC-P2-1: should guard against rapid double-click on Refresh button
verifies: Rapid double-click on Refresh is suppressed by useChildRefresh guard; only one refresh cycle executes and the button recovers to ready state

title: TC-P2-2: should transition staleness dot color over time (green → amber → red) — not wired: requires a 5+ minute CI wait budget for the amber→red threshold; impractical for standard CI runs without data-seeding a stale lastRunAt timestamp
verifies: Staleness dot auto-transitions green (<30s) → amber (30s-5m) → red (>5m) via 10s setInterval tick (test.fixme pending CI time budget)

title: TC-P2-3: should disable LLM Insights date picker in version-compare mode — not wired: programmatic entry into version-compare mode requires a child-dashboard action (sinceRollout/manual alignment) that has no exposed UI for direct test interaction; a dedicated test seeding step is needed first
verifies: Date picker is disabled in version-compare mode with OTooltip explaining why (test.fixme pending programmatic trigger)

title: TC-P2-4: should handle navigating away and returning without error
verifies: Navigating Sessions → Agent Graph → back to Sessions preserves header rendering and doesn't produce errors
